title: looks_like_bcrypt_hash aligns validation across from_credentials/validate/from_content
description: All three entry points (Config::validate for inline users, from_credentials for the API guard, from_content for file loading) now use the same looks_like_bcrypt_hash predicate including the length-60 check. Previously from_credentials used parse_bcrypt_cost (no length check), which could accept a syntactically valid but truncated hash string that would cause bcrypt::verify to fail silently at auth time. The alignment is correct and the comment at looks_like_bcrypt_hash explains why the length check exists.
